+    S_EXP = 2

+                d_sq = dx*dx + dy*dy + dz*dz
+                if d_sq < 1e-12:

+                fx = force_mag * dx / d
+                fy = force_mag * dy / d

+            tangent_y = fy - dot*yi
+            tangent_z = fz - dot*zi

+            new_y = yi + STEP_SIZE * tangent_y
+            new_z = zi + STEP_SIZE * tangent_z
+            norm = math.sqrt(new_x*new_x + new_y*new_y + new_z*new_z)
